title: Field lines of +2q and −q
caption: Line counts are proportional to charge: 20 lines leave +2q and 10 end on −q. The other 10 run off to infinity, as for a net charge of +q. Far away the field looks like that of a single +q. Between the charges the field points from + to −, and a null point, where the two fields cancel, lies on the axis beyond −q at 3.41 separations from +2q (2/s² = 1/(s − 1)² gives s = 1/(1 − 1/√2)).
alt: Field lines from a charge +2q on the left and a charge −q on the right: twice as many lines leave +2q as end on −q, and the rest spread outwards; a null point lies beyond −q.
description: Two point charges on a line: +2q on the left and −q on the right.
20 lines leave +2q; 10 of them curve round and end on −q.
The other 10 escape to infinity: the net charge is +q.
Beyond −q on the axis, at 3.41 separations from +2q, the two fields cancel exactly: a null point.

claims.name: the fields cancel at the null point beyond −q
